description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various categories, with 12 slices in total. The categories and their corresponding approximate percentages are: Econ. & Fin. (18.4%, light blue), an unlabeled category (24.3%, blue), Game&Anime (8.2%, orange), Business (5.9%, red), Geography (2.7%, yellow), Math (1.2%, green), Daily Life (7.1%, grey), Pet & Animal (5.5%, light green), Med & Health (6.7%, yellow), History (8.2%, dark orange), Law (5.1%, pink), and Science (6.7%, light purple). The chart includes percentage labels outside the slices, connected by lines to their corresponding categories, and the slices are visually distinguishable by their colors. The slices are not ordered in a particular way, and some categories have similar proportions.
